rule: Boss walk-in and kill order, as the code runs. Placement from the unique table by level (pack size 8, leashed when the table says so). Single-player HP halved, then difficulty multiplier and flat add. Leash: minion within 3 tiles of leader; leader moves only when its pack is complete. Talk gate: a talking boss does not attack until its speech effect stops (donor defect; ours uses a server timer). Death order: XP, kill count, loot, Diablo-only branch, death animation, quest kill check. Diablo camera drifts one tile per tick for 140 ticks, then the run ends. Seeded quest pool removes some boss quests per game. Enemy bar: unique name in gold-white; resist icons for uniques or after 15 kills.
keep: Timed talk hold before the first attack, so the threat is read first
Gold-white unique name on the enemy bar, and resist icons earned by kills
Unique corpse keeps its own tint and light
Order of death steps: reward first, then animation, then quest state
Leash ring around a pack; the leader waits for its pack
Seeded per-game pool of boss quests
change: Attack gate ends on a server timer, not on a sound effect ending (donor defect, fix: server holds talking state for intro_hold_ms; client plays the line)
Pack of 8 becomes at most 3 attacking (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3); the rest wait in the leash ring
No single-player HP halving; one HP value per boss from zone data and difficulty
Diablo-style death freeze and camera drift are client presentation only; server ends the fight at once
Gargoyle heal comment disagrees with its code (comment 1.47-25 percent, code max/64 to max/128); use our own value and fix the comment in our design doc
look_test: Target file src/fight/boss-staging.ts (new), parity row 9 (finisher staging). Look-test flag on the existing fight scene, no release rows. Three walk-ins at 375 wide (intro hold 0.5 s, 2 s, 3.5 s) with a gold name card, and two death drifts (2 s and 7 s). Dom says which hold reads as a threat without feeling slow.
